question: GraphReFly 的第一性身份是什么?
decision: reactive universal reduction layer；不限 LLM；性能 first-class
rationale: 任何高扇入/扇出→信息减少→推送 都是合法 segment；LLM 只是当前主攻不是边界

question: pre-1.0 锁不锁 wedge?
decision: 不锁 wedge，horizontal narrow-waist
rationale: 翻案 R11(memory+harness wedge)；每个原语须服务 ≥2 segment(F-NO-WEDGE-CUT)

question: 用户心智锚点?
decision: graph-first；describe() first-class output
rationale: graph 是人+LLM 共享认知锚点，比逐行代码快理解

question: L4 verb 集?
decision: 8 verb closed set: node/graph/batch/state + producer/derived/effect/mount
rationale: operator 不是 verb(是 node sugar)

question: Node vs Graph 职责?
decision: Node 最薄(无 inspection 杂质)；Graph 堆 convenience+inspection 唯一入口
rationale: 裸 node 可工作但无 inspection；g.* sugar 自动注册 inspection 索引

question: operator 是什么?
decision: operator = node sugar(不必经 derived)；spec 不收录；describe 看真名
rationale: 各语言独立实现，永不进 parity

question: handle 形态?
decision: handle = pure data (pool_id, handle_id)，无 method
rationale: 可 serialize/snapshot/wire-transfer；node≠handle(node 有 up/down method)

question: fn body 收发消息 API?
decision: ctx.up(msgs)/ctx.down(msgs)；一个 msgs array = 一个 Wave；可混 tier
rationale: 废 actions.emit/forward/backward；substrate boundary 统一 up/down

question: tier 集?
decision: 9 tier: DIRTY/DATA/RESOLVED/INVALIDATE/COMPLETE/ERROR/TEARDOWN + PAUSE/RESUME(control tier-0)
rationale: closed set；PAUSE/RESUME 正交 value 流

question: PAUSE/RESUME 形态?
decision: [[PAUSE, lock_id]]；lockset；caller 生成 id；同 id 幂等；RESUME 未知 no-op
rationale: 多来源 pause 不互相打架

question: message representation?
decision: in-process tuple / wire protobuf 解耦；转换在 wire-bridge 边界
rationale: tuple debug 友好；protobuf 紧凑；两层不强求一致

question: batch 形态?
decision: declarative(成功→commit/throw→rollback)+bctx.rollback escape；commit 永远隐式
rationale: 消灭忘记 commit 类 bug；3 语言天然对齐

question: cross-runtime?
decision: 每 runtime 本地 dispatcher + wire bridge；DIRTY 跨 wire 同 DATA 优先级；mesh 用户自接
rationale: R12 DIRTY consistency；mesh 不是 GraphReFly 的事

question: 形式化深度?
decision: γ: markdown spec + TLA+ + cross-impl property tests
rationale: 为我们自己的纪律(防 drift)，非为多实现(c aspirational)

question: equals 何时触发?
decision: equals 替换仅在 wave 内恰好 1 个 DATA 时；0 无关；≥2 不介入
rationale: 多 DATA 已无跳过-fn 收益

question: SENTINEL?
decision: protocol 概念(absence-of-DATA 可判定)；具体哨兵值 per-language(TS undefined/Rust None/Py sentinel)
rationale: 语义同，representation 解耦

question: terminal 后 resubscribe?
decision: terminal-is-forever 默认；resubscribable opt-in
rationale: 默认语义干净，TLA+ 状态空间小

question: messageTier config?
decision: messageTier = 编译期 const table；custom message type 扩展砍掉
rationale: 9 tier closed(D9)；加 tier=改 spec

question: onMessage/onSubscribe 可替换?
decision: substrate 固定，不可替换；观察用 inspector(read-only)，插逻辑加 node
rationale: F-NO-IMPL-DEFINED；砍 user 自定义协议栈

question: pool 1.0 必备?
decision: LocalSync + LocalAsync；dispatcher 留 pluggable pool trait
rationale: WorkerPool/RemotePool 等 wire bridge 成熟再加

question: dispatcher/pool 归属?
decision: dispatcher first-class；pool 挂 dispatcher；graph 绑 dispatcher(默认 process-global)
rationale: 多租户/sandbox 隔离自然

question: 并发单位?
decision: graph = 因果域 = 并发域 = 单线程；计算并行靠 pool callback；真并行靠多 graph+wire bridge；Rust 废 actor model；Py 废 subgraph 锁；rewire 仅 intra-graph
rationale: wave 协议无锁；graph 边界=并发边界可解释；subgraph 回归纯组织

question: store?
decision: ctx.state per-node 私有(隐式 OK)；graph-level 共享 memory = 显式 node+dep
rationale: 私有 state 不违反 graph-first；共享 memory 必须可 inspect

question: parity 机制?
decision: behavioral conformance 替代 structural Impl；cross-track-ledger 退役
rationale: parity 从符号集对齐降维成协议行为符合；operator/sugar/inspection 各语言独立永不进 parity

question: snapshot/restore?
decision: 拓扑+cache+factory-name；restore 按 name re-resolve；增量 changeset；inline fn 标 local-only
rationale: fn 不能 serialize，factory registry 模式

question: central config singleton?
decision: 完全消解：messageTier=const；onMessage/onSubscribe=substrate 固定；operational config=graph/dispatcher opts；clock=graph-local monotonic；唯一 global singleton=default dispatcher；freeze 机制消失
rationale: L3.C graph=因果域天然隔离；config drift+freeze 时序复杂性消除

question: sugar 怎么注册?
decision: sugar→ctx-fn 转换严格在 graph layer；dispatcher/node 只认 (ctx)=>void
rationale: 各语言 sugar 自由，dispatcher/node 统一 → 喂 behavioral parity(D24)

question: cleanup hook?
decision: ctx.onDeactivation + ctx.onInvalidate (2 hook)；砍 onRerun(0 callsite)/onResubscribableReset(1→ctx.state)
rationale: 内部 state reset 归 ctx.state lifecycle，cleanup 只管外部资源+INVALIDATE

question: ctx.state lifecycle?
decision: 默认 fresh-lifecycle wipe；ctx.state.persist(boolean?) 保留
rationale: frozen-context 等 latch 自动清；persist 跨 lifecycle

question: error+cancellation?
decision: throw→ERROR(graph-layer catch)；cancellation 默认不取消，{switch:true} opt-in+AbortSignal via ctx
rationale: JS/Py throw 是常态；取消是 async pool 特性最少惊讶

question: error typed?
decision: error=unknown(Node<T> 单泛型)
rationale: error typed 类型组合爆炸；跨语言 Box<dyn Error>/Exception 是顶类型

question: 包结构?
decision: 每语言独立完整包(@graphrefly/ts·rust·py)+粗粒度 wire bridge；无跨语言 peer-deps
rationale: 甩掉 D080/D206+9.5× 机器税；放弃 never-functional 的 TS-on-Rust-substrate 幻想

question: wire codec?
decision: wire=protobuf schema-codegen(单 .proto 兼 wire+protocol contract IDL)；实现 defer post-1.0
rationale: DR-2 IDL 单源

question: §5.11 ctx-level 暴露 tier?
decision: §5.11 amend：ctx-level(node/producer)是 protocol-facing power surface 有意暴露 tier；value-level(derived/effect/operator)是 §5.11-compliant primary
rationale: ctx.down 一-wave-多-tier 原子性(terminal-with-final-value)是 emit/error 方法表达不了的

question: parity 加 IDL?
decision: A+C: behavioral conformance + L6-Q3 的 .proto 兼 protocol contract IDL；codegen 接口骨架(轻 structural 单源)
rationale: 纯 behavioral 失去 structural 保证；.proto 本就要写，零额外成本买接口形状一致

question: async-result-at-paused-node?
decision: 进 pause buffer + RESUME replay
rationale: 与 PAUSE 缓冲 DATA 一致；lock_id 作用域=node-level pause_lockset

question: graph 职责过载?
decision: 先不引入独立 domain 概念(narrow-waist 优先)；记逃生口
rationale: 若 inspection 边界 vs 并发边界冲突真实出现，引入 domain(一 domain 含多 graph)

question: conformance 硬场景?
decision: 必含：跨 graph diamond / async-result-at-paused-node / INVALIDATE×ctx.state×onInvalidate / mixed sync-async diamond / PAUSE lockset 多来源；spec amendment 清单(§5.10/5.11/6.1/7.1+3 新增)
rationale: 否则 behavioral parity 是空头支票

question: dispatcher opts 结构?
decision: 分组 {limits, observability, policy}
rationale: 避免平铺十几个 key 的认知负担

question: CSP-0: canonical messageTier const table (numbering + START placement)?
decision: 7-tier const table: 0 START(handshake) / 1 PAUSE·RESUME(control) / 2 DIRTY(notification) / 3 DATA·RESOLVED(value) / 4 INVALIDATE(settle) / 5 COMPLETE·ERROR(terminal) / 6 TEARDOWN; immediate <3, batch-deferred ≥3
rationale: old-spec numbering with PAUSE/RESUME↔DIRTY swap (control before notification); START=10th handshake type, D9's 9 protocol types occupy tiers 1-6; amends R-tier numbering

question: CSP-0: dynamicNode/track(dep) disposition vs D4 8-verb + D22 rewire?
decision: carry as intra-graph node construction variant (NOT a verb): superset deps declared at construction + track(dep) read-selection per invocation; unread-dep update fires fn then equals-absorbs; same first-run gate; inter-graph N/A (cross-graph deps only via wire bridge)
rationale: distinct mechanism from rewire (per-invocation read-selection vs dep-set mutation); D22 bounds all tracked deps to one causal domain

question: CSP-0: meta companion stores substrate or presentation?
decision: presentation/graph-layer, NOT substrate: static annotations (description/type/range/...) → describe metadata via g.node opts; reactive annotations → explicit nodes (D23); substrate node carries zero meta machinery; meta.owner ABAC is presentation/multi-agent
rationale: D5 node=thinnest with zero inspection cruft; meta is pure annotation feeding describe (graph owns inspection)

question: B10: synchronous feedback-cycle / re-entrant fn semantics — queue (A), reject (B), or require-async (C)?
decision: reject, not iterate (B, owned at graph level): a node fn that during its invocation transitively re-drives one of its own deps so the same node's fn would re-enter before its wave completes is a wave-level protocol ERROR. Detection is node-local and free — refuse to enter the fn-run while the node's own in-wave flag (_insideRunWave) is already set, and throw; the graph layer catches the throw → [[ERROR,e]] down (D30), located at the cycle-closing node, wave aborted. The core neither queues (A) nor bounds-then-runs the cycle. Legit accumulation = per-node ctx.state (scan), not a topological cycle. Async feedback crossing a turn boundary (async pool) is out of scope. No maxFnRerunDepth — precise flag detection supersedes the blunt depth cap
rationale: A normalizes imperative-control-flow-as-topology (feedback_no_imperative) and does not root-fix; B fixes the root with zero new structure by checking the already-existing _insideRunWave flag; dispatcher stays a pure invoke funnel (F-DISPATCH-ALL); error ownership is graph-level per the wave-level error category (D30); surfaced by CSP-1 /qa (backlog B10)

question: B11: what does a depless source do with an upstream-forwarded control message (INVALIDATE/DIRTY/TEARDOWN) at the terminus?
decision: the source self-ACTS only on a message with a coherent round-trip: INVALIDATE → HONOR the invalidate-request (clear cache→SENTINEL, fire onInvalidate, broadcast INVALIDATE downstream = self _invalidate; the down-cascade clears the reachable downstream cone; a node guard may deny it per R-observe, dropping silently). DIRTY → DROP/no-op (a source has no downstream-driven recompute; self-dirty would wedge downstream awaiting a settle that never comes). TEARDOWN → DROP/no-op (source lifecycle is source/graph-owned, not destroyable by a downstream request; revisit on a real cascade-teardown-up consumer). Dep-bearing intermediates only forward upstream control (no self-action); the source is the single actor, the down-cascade the effect
rationale: R-ctx-up/DR-5 deliberately lists INVALIDATE as up-allowed (unlike PAUSE/RESUME which have lockset handling) — the only self-consistent reason to allow it up is for the terminus source to honor it (DS-1 L1.11 'invalidate-request'); it is a cache-drop request not an imperative WRITE (the next value still comes from the source side), so it respects no-imperative + source-owns-value; DIRTY/TEARDOWN have no coherent terminus action. Closes the F-NO-IMPL-DEFINED gap (B11)

question: pre-CSP-2 gate 3: pin the inspection data shapes (describe schema / observe stream protocol / profile metrics)?
decision: describe = flat JSON-serializable snapshot {name?; nodes:DNode[]; edges:{from,to}[]; subgraphs?}, DNode={id (stable mount-aware :: path, auto-numbered when unnamed), name?, factory (real operator name per D6/L1.5), status (R-status-enum), value? (absent=SENTINEL/never-emitted), deps:id[], meta? (static annotations, R-meta-presentation)}; edges derived (R-edges-derived); explain mode = causal-chain subset; renderers are pure fns over the snapshot. observe = read-only enveloped EGRESS (NOT a graph node — avoids self-observation island, D19 read-only), item ObserveEvent={path, msg, tier, seq (graph-local clock, D26)}; one shape for single/subtree/whole-graph. profile = opt-in accumulated-counter snapshot {waves; nodes:Record<path,{invokes,emits,resolved,errored,duration?}>}, backed by an opt-in dispatcher/graph recorder (F-DISPATCH-ALL invoke funnel), NEVER on the thin node (R-node-thin), default-off (F-PERF). All three share the mount-aware :: path key + status/tier/seq metadata. Streaming describe / live-topology = an observe topology-event, DEFERRED to CSP-2 viz
rationale: 守 R-node-thin (profile→dispatcher recorder, not node); observe read-only egress avoids self-observation island + honors D19; consistent with the already-drafted R-describe/R-observe (only pins exact fields + adds R-profile). Inspection is per-language, never in parity (D24) — these rules DOCUMENT the cross-lang contract (covers_by:[], no conformance/TLA+), they do not gate parity
